content.content:
If you're the person your data team leans on, and you already do much of a lead's job without the title, I work with you on the part of the job that isn't code. That's getting the next request prioritised or turned down without a fight, getting your work seen by the people who fund the team, and building the case for the title.

I teach what I didn't have the first time I led a team, and I'm on my second go now. I went from data engineer to Head of Data Engineering on a fast track, with a 40% salary increase.

Most career advice for this is either motivational LinkedIn bullshit or written for managers who already have direct reports, and neither helps when you're doing the job without the title.

## The record

- Named one of Bulgaria's Top 100 Tech Talents, 2025.
- Delivered the data platform behind a $73M Series C.
- Grew the data function from one engineer to a cross-functional team.
- Cut Snowflake platform costs by 70% and reinvested in headcount and AI/ML.
- Handled data due diligence on 2 acquisitions, with go/no-go recommendations inside 2 weeks.

![](/images/journey.png)
